name: game-day-app
install: npm ci && npx playwright install --with-deps chromium

terminals.name: dev
terminals.description: Vite dev server for the Game Day app (Parent Hub). Serves the SPA and the local /api/manifest middleware on http://127.0.0.1:5173. Requires VITE_SUPABASE_URL and VITE_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY secrets to load team data.
